summary: A Quote subscription on an NSE index (segment NIDX): the index packet carries the prices only.

notes: Frames follow the INDstocks price socket's documented shape (indmoney_adapter.py:575-583: mode, instrument, timestamp in ms, data) with fractional prices so a price's JSON type is not what differs.

deviations.reason: The index packet carries no volume; the web sends 0 for it (get_value's default, indmoney_adapter.py:651-665), the desktop leaves it out. A field the broker did not send is left out, never sent as 0 (docs; lead decision on web zeros, 2026-11-09).

INDmoney's web adapter sends no change for any instrument; the desktop sends an index's change worked out from the previous close. Lead decision: an index's price_change follows the adapter, so it is left out; waits on lane wire's per-broker index_change dialect switch.
